scope: P1/E7 minimum validation: replanning-frequency axis only
reason_for_reduction: User requested a small validation. Isolate actual planner-to-executor update frequency while keeping brief content and GOAI schema fixed; do not claim the full ambiguous six-configuration two-axis checklist design.
scheduling: Validate the first interval-10 case before expansion; then prioritize longer interval-2/5 cases and use the freed replica for interval-10 within each seed. Rotate replica preference across seeds.
primary_gain: Within-seed native grid utility minus the same-seed fixed pure-RL reference, not the maximum of untested pure baselines
saturation_check: Descriptive adjacent-interval mean utility increment <=0.05 while observed interface cost increases; three-seed pilot is not confirmatory evidence of a universal saturation point
invalid_interventions: RL controller failure on active unit
